**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1678476
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**EY GDS – Data and Analytics (D\&A) – Senior – Senior Data Scientist**

  


**Role Overview:**

  




We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Scientist with a minimum of 3 \- 7 years of experience in Data Science and Machine Learning, preferably with experience in NLP, Generative AI, LLMs, MLOps, Optimization techniques, and AI solution Architecture. In this role, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of AI solutions, leveraging your technical expertise. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of AI technologies and experience in designing and implementing cutting\-edge AI models and systems. Additionally, expertise in data engineering, DevOps, and MLOps practices will be valuable in this role.

  


**Responsibilities:**

  


**Your technical responsibilities:**

  


* Contribute to the design and implementation of state\-of\-the\-art AI solutions.
* Assist in the development and implementation of AI models and systems, leveraging techniques such as Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business opportunities and define AI project goals.
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in generative AI techniques, such as LLMs, and evaluate their potential applications in solving enterprise challenges.
* Utilize generative AI techniques, such as LLMs, to develop innovative solutions for enterprise industry use cases.
* Integrate with relevant APIs and libraries, such as Azure Open AI GPT models and Hugging Face Transformers, to leverage pre\-trained models and enhance generative AI capabilities.
* Implement and optimize end\-to\-end pipelines for generative AI projects, ensuring seamless data processing and model deployment.
* Utilize vector databases, such as Redis, and NoSQL databases to efficiently handle large\-scale generative AI datasets and outputs.
* Implement similarity search algorithms and techniques to enable efficient and accurate retrieval of relevant information from generative AI outputs.
* Collaborate with domain experts, stakeholders, and clients to understand specific business requirements and tailor generative AI solutions accordingly.
* Conduct research and evaluation of advanced AI techniques, including transfer learning, domain adaptation, and model compression, to enhance performance and efficiency.
* Establish evaluation metrics and methodologies to assess the quality, coherence, and relevance of generative AI outputs for enterprise industry use cases.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and ethical considerations in AI applications.
* Leverage data engineering skills to curate, clean, and preprocess large\-scale datasets for generative AI applications.

  


**Requirements:**

  


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. A Ph.D. is a plus.
* Minimum 3\-7 years of experience in Data Science and Machine Learning.
* In\-depth knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI techniques.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, and frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Strong understanding of NLP techniques and frameworks such as BERT, GPT, or Transformer models.
* Familiarity with computer vision techniques for image recognition, object detection, or image generation.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and deploying AI solutions in a cloud environment.
* Expertise in data engineering, including data curation, cleaning, and preprocessing.
* Knowledge of trusted AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI models and systems.
* Strong collaboration with software engineering and operations teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of AI models.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at various levels.
* Understanding of data privacy, security, and ethical considerations in AI applications.
* Track record of driving innovation and staying updated with the latest AI research and advancements.

  


**Good to Have Skills:**

  


* Apply trusted AI practices to ensure fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI models and systems.
* Utilize optimization tools and techniques, including MIP (Mixed Integer Programming).
* Drive DevOps and MLOps practices, covering continuous integration, deployment, and monitoring of AI models.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for streamlined model deployment and scaling processes.
* Utilize tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Git to build and manage AI pipelines.
* Apply infrastructure as code (IaC) principles, employing tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Implement monitoring and logging tools to ensure AI model performance and reliability.
* Collaborate seamlessly with software engineering and operations teams for efficient AI model integration and deployment.
* Familiarity with DevOps and MLOps practices, including continuous integration, deployment, and monitoring of AI models.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: MIS Executive – Data Operations & Database Management
description:
Job Description: MIS Executive – Data Operations \& Database Management

**Location:** Sovabazar, Kolkata  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Department:** MIS / Data Operations  
**Reports To:** Designated Reporting Authority / Operations Leadership

**About IND**

The Institute of NeuroDevelopment (IND) is a mission\-driven organisation working with children with autism and other neurodevelopmental differences and their families.

As IND grows across programmes, services, parent engagement, assessments, operations and digital initiatives, accurate and well\-structured data becomes essential to effective decision\-making and execution.

We are looking for an **MIS Executive – Data Operations \& Database Management** who can ensure that organisational data remains **accurate, complete, consistent, structured, accessible and usable**.

This is a hands\-on data operations role requiring strong attention to detail, analytical thinking and comfort working with large datasets and multiple digital systems.

Role Summary

The MIS Executive will be responsible for maintaining and improving the quality of IND's operational data and databases.

The role will involve:

* Data entry and updating
* Data validation
* Data cleaning
* Duplicate identification
* Data reconciliation
* Database maintenance
* MIS reporting
* CSV preparation and bulk uploads
* Data extraction and transformation
* Cross\-system data verification
* Identification of discrepancies
* Supporting operational teams with accurate information

The person will work with data originating from multiple teams and systems and will often need to identify missing information, trace discrepancies and coordinate with the relevant team members to resolve them.

The role requires **accuracy first, but not accuracy alone**. The candidate should also be able to understand patterns in data, identify recurring problems and suggest ways of improving the underlying data processes.

Key Responsibilities1\. Data Operations

* Maintain organisational databases and structured datasets.
* Enter, update and organise information according to defined data structures.
* Ensure that records are complete and appropriately formatted.
* Maintain consistency across databases and reporting systems.
* Process data received from different teams and sources.
* Ensure timely updating of operational records.

2\. Data Validation \& Quality Control

Regularly identify and resolve:

* Missing records
* Duplicate records
* Incorrect IDs
* Incorrect or inconsistent names
* Mismatched information
* Missing fields
* Invalid formats
* Data entry errors
* Inconsistent categorisation
* Records that do not reconcile across systems

Establish appropriate validation checks to minimise recurring errors.

3\. Data Cleaning \& Reconciliation

* Clean large datasets while preserving data integrity.
* Reconcile information across multiple files or systems.
* Compare source data against master databases.
* Identify discrepancies between datasets.
* Investigate the source of inconsistencies.
* Coordinate with relevant team members to obtain missing or corrected information.
* Maintain appropriate records of corrections where required.

4\. Database Management

Maintain structured databases relating to areas such as:

* Leads
* Enquiries
* Webinar registrations
* Webinar attendance
* Programme enrolments
* Parent/client records
* Assessments
* Sessions
* Staff
* Recruitment
* Operational activities
* Other organisational databases

Ensure that databases follow approved structures, naming conventions and access controls.

5\. MIS Reporting

Prepare regular and ad hoc MIS reports as required by the organisation.

This may include:

* Operational reports
* Programme reports
* Attendance reports
* Lead reports
* Enrollment reports
* Conversion\-related data
* Team performance data
* Data\-quality reports
* Management dashboards
* Other management information

Reports should be accurate, clearly structured and delivered within agreed timelines.

6\. Spreadsheet Management

Work confidently with large datasets using:

* Microsoft Excel
* Google Sheets

The candidate should be comfortable using:

* VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP
* INDEX\-MATCH
* COUNTIF / COUNTIFS
* IF / IFS
* FILTER
* SORT
* UNIQUE
* Pivot Tables
* Conditional Formatting
* Data Validation
* Other relevant spreadsheet functions

The ability to structure data efficiently and troubleshoot spreadsheet errors is important.

7\. CSV \& Bulk Data Operations

* Create and validate CSV files.
* Prepare data for bulk uploads.
* Follow predefined import formats.
* Validate files before upload.
* Identify errors that may cause upload failures.
* Support bulk data migration or updating where required.
* Maintain appropriate versions of bulk\-upload files.

8\. Data Collection \& Completion

Work with different teams to ensure that required information is available.

This may involve:

* Identifying missing information.
* Contacting relevant team members.
* Clarifying discrepancies.
* Following up for incomplete records.
* Verifying information before updating the database.
* Maintaining appropriate documentation of unresolved data issues.

The objective is not simply to report that information is missing, but to help bring the dataset to a usable state.

9\. Cross\-System Data Management

Work with information across platforms such as:

* Google Drive
* Google Forms
* Google Sheets
* Zoom
* Google Meet
* YouTube
* LMS platforms
* CRM systems
* Other internal databases and operational platforms

The candidate should be able to understand how information flows from one system to another and identify where discrepancies arise.

**10\. Data Security \& Confidentiality**

The role may involve access to sensitive organisational and client information.

The candidate must:

* Maintain confidentiality.
* Follow approved access controls.
* Avoid unauthorised sharing or downloading of data.
* Follow organisational data\-handling procedures.
* Maintain appropriate file permissions.
* Exercise caution when using external tools or AI systems with organisational data.

**11\. Process Improvement**

The MIS Executive should not merely correct the same errors repeatedly.

Where recurring data problems are identified, the person should:

* Identify the pattern.
* Investigate the likely cause.
* Recommend improvements to the data collection process.
* Improve validation mechanisms where authorised.
* Suggest changes to forms, templates or database structures.
* Help reduce recurring manual correction.

This is an important part of the role as IND's data systems mature.

**12\. AI \& Automation**

IND is progressively adopting AI and automation across its workflows.

The candidate should therefore be willing to learn and appropriately use AI\-enabled tools for activities such as:

* Data analysis
* Data cleaning assistance
* Transcript processing
* Information extraction
* Data classification
* Operational documentation
* Repetitive data\-processing tasks
* Workflow improvement

AI familiarity is an **added advantage**, not a substitute for fundamental data accuracy and spreadsheet/database skills.

The candidate must also understand that confidential organisational or client information should not be entered into external AI tools unless authorised.

Profile Requirements:

Educational Qualification

**Graduate in:**

* BBA
* BCA
* Statistics
* Mathematics
* Computer Applications
* Data\-related disciplines
* Or another relevant field

Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in MIS, Data Operations, Data Management, Data Validation, Reporting or similar roles.
* Experience working with large datasets is preferred.
* Experience working across multiple operational databases or systems will be an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

Strong working knowledge of:

* Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets
* Data validation
* Data cleaning
* Data reconciliation
* Database maintenance
* Spreadsheet\-based reporting
* CSV preparation
* Bulk\-upload formats

Strong familiarity with functions and tools such as:

* VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP
* INDEX\-MATCH
* COUNTIF / COUNTIFS
* IF / IFS
* FILTER
* SORT
* UNIQUE
* Pivot Tables
* Conditional Formatting
* Data Validation

**Additional Technical Exposure**

The following will be advantageous:

* CRM systems
* LMS platforms
* Lead management systems
* Enrollment databases
* Operational databases
* Google Forms
* Google Drive
* Zoom
* Google Meet
* YouTube
* Basic data visualisation
* Basic automation
* AI\-assisted data workflows

**Personal Competencies**

The successful candidate should have:

**Exceptional Attention to Detail**

Ability to notice discrepancies that may not be immediately obvious.

**Accuracy**

Ability to work carefully even when dealing with large volumes of repetitive information.

**Analytical Thinking**

Ability to understand patterns, identify anomalies and investigate discrepancies.

**Problem Solving**

Ability to determine why a data problem has occurred and work towards resolution.

**Organisation**

Ability to maintain structured datasets, files and databases.

**Persistence**

Ability to follow through when information is incomplete or discrepancies need to be resolved.

**Communication**

Ability to coordinate with multiple teams to obtain missing or corrected information.

**Confidentiality**

Ability to handle organisational and client data responsibly.

**Learning Agility**

Willingness to learn new CRM, LMS, database, automation and AI systems.

What Success Looks Like

A successful MIS Executive at IND should progressively help create a situation where:

* Data is accurate.
* Data is complete.
* Duplicate records are minimised.
* Missing information is identified quickly.
* Reports can be generated reliably.
* Different systems contain consistent information.
* Data problems are identified before they affect operations.
* Teams can access the information they need.
* Management can rely on MIS reports for decision\-making.
* Recurring data errors are progressively eliminated at their source.

The role is therefore not merely about **"making reports."**

It is about ensuring that **IND's data can be trusted**.

**Growth Opportunities**

Depending on performance and demonstrated capabilities, the role can progress towards:

**MIS Executive – Data Operations \& Database Management**  
↓  
**Senior MIS Executive / Data Operations Specialist**  
↓  
**MIS \& Systems Lead**  
↓  
**Data Operations / Systems Manager**  
↓  
**Systems \& Data Architect / Head of Systems**

Candidates who demonstrate strong analytical ability, systems thinking and an aptitude for automation may progressively take on responsibilities beyond routine MIS into **systems design, workflow optimisation, automation and organisational intelligence**.

**Key Performance Areas**

The role may be evaluated on:

* **Data Accuracy**
* **Data Completeness**
* **Timeliness of Data Updates**
* **Reporting Accuracy**
* **Database Integrity**
* **Reconciliation \& Error Resolution**
* **Bulk Data Processing Accuracy**
* **Responsiveness to Data Requirements**
* **Reduction of Recurring Data Errors**
* **Process \& Data Quality Improvements**

Pay: ₹14,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: QA senior lead
description:
QA Senior Lead (Contract/FTE) Experience: 11–15 Years Company \- LTI Mindtree Location: Kolkata Budget: As per Market Standards Role Overview We are looking for a QA Senior Lead to lead quality assurance for a large\-scale, cloud\-native media content platform handling massive volumes of media data including articles, videos, and audio. The role will focus on API testing, data validation, automation, performance testing, and QA strategy, while leading the team and driving quality across the complete data lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Lead and mentor QA engineers and define the overall QA strategy. Drive Shift\-Left testing and integrate quality practices across the SDLC. Own end\-to\-end testing for data ingestion, processing, storage, and API consumption. Test ingestion workflows, SNS/SQS, scheduled jobs, and REST APIs including keyword, category, and semantic search. Perform large\-scale validation of JSON datasets using AWS S3, Athena, SQL, and Glue Crawlers. Validate metadata, mappings, date logic, filtering, and data accuracy across multiple sources. Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks using JavaScript/Jest and/or Python/Pytest. Integrate API automation and JSON schema validation into CI/CD pipelines. Design and execute high\-volume load and performance testing using Locust. Analyse bottlenecks across ALB, ECS, downstream services, API latency, and search performance.
